features.title: Decimals → explanatory exact fractions
features.meaning: Fractions reveal exact shares, reciprocal pairs, and common parts of a balance. They are not a costume for every number. Approximate results stay decimals or exact roots; ordinary values use compact units. Above one, a chosen fraction is improper, never mixed.

1.note: Mostly legible decimals; keep illuminating ratios and identities.

2.note: The determined visitor sees fifths at 6-a; later fractions are chosen for a relationship, not required for every result.

3.note: Established exact ratios from the start; rounded results remain readable decimals or roots.

4.note: Exact relationships available to verse; decimals and compact units remain available for ordinary quantities.

features.evidence: doc: path 1 mostly decimals; path 2 drops them soon; path 3 fractions from the start. doc: toward the middle the determined visitor finds decimals obscure the meaning; fractions bring it back. doc: 40 g m2. R-131: no approximate fractions; inertia/spin in g m², kilo/milli prefixes carry zeros. doc: paperclip behavior is optimizing the visible rule until it loses its purpose.

precision.note: These identify roundings already present in the checked model. Changing number style never promotes them to exact physical results.
